description: Find scheduled generator retirements within a time horizon that could free grid capacity for a target MW, with the nearest substations to each.

fuel_filter.description: Optional filter for retiring fuel categories, substring-matched (e.g., 'Coal', 'Natural Gas', 'Petroleum').

horizon_months.description: Time horizon in months to look ahead for planned retirements, 1-120 (e.g., 12, 18, 36).

limit.description: Max results to return (1-500; default varies by tool)

region_iso.description: Optional target region or ISO (e.g., 'MISO', 'PJM', 'ERCOT', 'SPP', 'CAISO', 'NYISO', 'ISONE'). Matches the generator's own EIA balancing-authority code — real market boundaries, not state lines. Comma-separated for a union.

target_mw.description: Minimum required headroom in megawatts (MW) — filters to retiring generators at/above this size. Also passed through as the handoff's analyze_site capacity_mw (the DC you are siting).

name: get_retirement_headroom
title: Get Retirement Headroom
